headline: Trump: Oil is flowing through the Hormuz Strait. The Countries of the World, should, and will, reimburse the US

predictions.mechanism: A claim that oil is again flowing through Hormuz is a de-escalation signal that can reduce energy-supply risk, inflation pressure and equity risk premium.
predictions.invalidation: Independent shipping evidence shows flows remain severely impaired or new attacks disrupt the strait.

predictions.mechanism: Lower perceived oil-supply risk can reduce inflation and rate pressure, supporting duration-sensitive technology equities.
predictions.invalidation: Oil remains near highs, yields keep rising, or the Hormuz-flow claim is contradicted.

predictions.mechanism: A credible easing of Hormuz disruption would reduce geopolitical safe-haven demand for gold.
predictions.invalidation: Fresh military escalation or evidence that Hormuz shipping remains effectively blocked revives safe-haven demand.
